title: Privacy Policy
intro: This portfolio website is owned and managed by Muhammad Idlan. This policy explains what information may be collected when you use the website and how it is used.

sections.heading: Information I Collect
sections.body: If you use the contact form, I collect the name, email address, and message you choose to send. This website may also receive basic technical information, such as browser type or IP address, through hosting and security logs.

sections.heading: How I Use Your Information
sections.body: I use contact form details only to read your message and reply to you. I do not sell your personal information or use it for unrelated marketing.

sections.heading: Where Your Message Goes
sections.body: Contact form submissions may be processed by the website hosting provider and delivered to my email inbox so I can respond.

sections.heading: Cookies and Analytics
sections.body: This portfolio does not intentionally use advertising cookies or marketing trackers. If analytics or embedded third-party tools are added later, this policy should be updated.

sections.heading: Data Retention
sections.body: I keep messages only for as long as needed to reply, manage project conversations, or keep reasonable records.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: If you have questions about this privacy policy, contact me at idlan9114@gmail.com.
